method: Original local HTML files in isolated installed Chrome. Native DevTools keyboard input for Tab, Shift+Tab, arrows, Enter, Escape, Home, and End; browser viewport emulation at 320px, 390px, and 1366px. Reduced motion enabled for stable captures. Direct DOM checks exercise valid/invalid input and project calculations. No email app was opened and no message was sent.
